verdict.rationale: The evidence never shows Mastra shipping first-party integrations that wrap external AI SDKs, agent frameworks, or model providers so that agent steps become durable. Its model routing to 90+ providers is about connectivity, not durability. Workflow retries and suspend/resume are Mastra's own workflow primitives, not wrappers over a user's existing AI stack, so they are only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As an agent builder, first-party integrations wrap my AI stack — AI SDKs, agent frameworks, model providers — so agent steps get durability without glue code
